text_block_list.text: The new year. While understanding that her passion for racing was still low compared to other Umamusume—

"I decided that our primary goal for this year
would be the Classic Triple Crown."
I knew it wasn't that she lacked motivation, and yet—

Above all else, if you seek even greater speed,
entering races is an indispensable tool.
choice_data_list: (I'm sure they'll grow even more through racing!)

text_block_list.text: And so, wanting to focus on racing soon, I tried writing my New Year's calligraphy to "visualize my goals," but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Calling a meeting so early in the New Year... You really never change.
She noticed the New Year's calligraphy placed on the desk.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What's this? The "Classic Triple Crown"?
choice_data_list: It's our goal for this year—yours and mine.
It's a goal for you and me this year.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed, I heard that from you!
I'm giving it positive consideration!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"However, there is no guarantee you will actually be able to enter.
I believe I have told you this before."
choice_data_list: (I want to respect her wishes. But...)

text_block_list.text:
If she truly aimed to enter the race, it was about time
to get serious. That pivotal moment was fast approaching.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. "It'd be a waste not to make full use
of the Classics stage," is it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I get what you mean. Racing against formidable
opponents could be just the trigger
you need to attain even greater speed."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, as I told you before—
no, just a moment ago—I—
choice_data_list: It'll also serve as the perfect place for data collection!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Heh! You certainly are persistent!
You really want me to participate by any means necessary, don't you!

With a laugh,
she rested her hand on her chin for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Well, you have a point. Understood.
Let's at least pencil in the Satsuki Sho, then.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It is the wish of my dear guin—Trainer-kun!
Turning you down time and time again makes even my heart ache, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And above all else, being able to collect data
is quite appealing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Since we're here today,
shall we brainstorm some strategies for the Yayoi Sho and Satsuki Sho?
choice_data_list: (It's rare to see you so enthusiastic about something other than research...!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't look so surprised.
Even I have a lot going on.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"You'd still feed a lab rat, wouldn't you?
It's the same thing. So, what'll it be?"
choice_data_list: Time to make a wish at Hatsumode!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, a strategy meeting! Now that's what I'm talking about!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: First, let's identify the Umamusume who seem to be aiming for this year's Yayoi Sho.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Once we understand their traits, personalities, strengths, and weaknesses,
we'll plug them into VR and run mock battles against them!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mental training is significant for
succeeding at all kinds of things.
Honestly, it doesn't even have to be a mock race.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
For example, a 50m sprint, or hurdles...
...Wait, what if we made a chimera of them—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If we customize all five limbs... no, even all the internal organs separately,
what kind of body will even be born from that!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! I'm getting excited! To the laboratory!
Today, I shall specially appoint you as my assistant!
That day was entirely spent keeping an eye on her before she completely lost her sense of ethics...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm?
So you want to soak in the New Year's spirit together, is that it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure about that? It's not often
that I actually get in the mood for this, you know?
choice_data_list: Might as well, while we're at it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well... occasionally, it should be fine. Besides,
that has a high carbohydrate content. It is ideal
as an energy source for the brain and training.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, wait a minute, wouldn't glucose suffice then?
Why go through the trouble of ingesting it
from something so difficult to swallow?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Right, decided. Guinea pig, run to a nearby shop
and buy some glucose tablets for me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, while you're at it, get some folic acid and iron too!
And some ethanol, as well.

And so, right at the start of the New Year, for some reason,
I ended up being roped into running errands...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Making wishes, huh...
To be honest, I haven't done that much.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, I find it a rather intriguing custom.
In the end, it's merely a reaffirmation of one's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"No... wait, if you show a placebo effect,
I can observe it right up close, can't I...?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! New Year's shrine visit sounds great!
Let's head out right away, full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Draw a fortune slip while you're at it!
Aim for Great Curse or Great Blessing if you can!

Afterward, at the shrine grounds we visited,
I was relentlessly questioned about what I had wished for...
